hypothesis: R221 is the only candidate so far that passed every pre-registered D/G gate (full +9.12%, discovery -14.68%, validation +28.96%, recent 12m +8.02%, rolling-1y positive 61.80%). Before treating it as a paper-trading candidate, it must survive cost and position-count stress. This round freezes the R221 factor and strategy and tests a pre-specified cost/capacity matrix: costs 3x/4x/5x/6x and max positions 5/10/20. The hypothesis is that R221 remains positive at 4x and 5x costs and across position counts, rather than depending on a single configuration.

factor.definition: frozen from R221; TTM selling-plus-management expense ratio inverted, four consecutive quarters

stress_matrix.cost_definition: 3x baseline: 6bp fees + 6bp commission + 15bp slippage + 10bp stamp tax; higher multipliers scale all four cost components proportionally

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

gates.R1: baseline 3x / max_positions 10 full-sample total return reproduces R221 evidence within 0.5pp
gates.R2: 4x / max_positions 10 full-sample total return is positive
gates.R3: 5x / max_positions 10 full-sample total return is positive
gates.R4: 4x / max_positions 10 recent-12m total return is positive
gates.R5: all 3x max_positions variants (5/10/20) have positive full-sample total return
gates.R6: all 3x max_positions variants (5/10/20) have positive recent-12m total return
gates.R7: worst full-sample total return across 3x and 4x variants is greater than -5%
gates.R8: worst full-sample MDD across 3x and 4x variants is no worse than -45%
gates.R9: baseline rolling-1y positive rate is at least 55% and its 5th-percentile rolling return is greater than -20%

decision_rule: All R gates must pass. The factor definition, scoring weights, universe, holding period and stop loss are frozen. Any failed gate rejects the deployment claim; no post-result tuning of cost, position count, universe or weights is allowed.
known_limitations: This is a stress test of an existing factor, not an independent new alpha discovery.
The cost multipliers are proportional scaling of the baseline 3x cost model, not a full market-impact model.
Position count changes concentration but does not model capacity in yuan.
R221's full-sample MDD is already -32.97%; the stress test only rejects if MDD worsens beyond -45%.
The result remains research-only; passing stress gates would justify paper trading, not production deployment.
